articles.title: Budget 2027: FM Sitharaman chairs third pre-Budget consultation with manufacturing sector leaders

articles.desc: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced a three percent hike in Dearness Allowance for government employees. Approximately 8.5 lakh government employees and pensioners will receive this additional financial support. Payments reflecting the increased DA will be included in the November salary.
